article.hook: That impulse to say yes before you know what you’re saying yes to just sharpened. Venus in Sagittarius pulls attraction toward the new and the wide-open, where love is a question mark, not a period.
article.lived: For nearly a month, you’ll find yourself reaching for the door before the conversation ends, booking tickets before the plan is clear, and laughing louder at jokes that stretch far from your usual taste. Attraction grows when curiosity rides shotgun and honesty cuts through small talk. We share unexpected truths in moments that feel like the start of something bigger - even if the finish line isn’t on the map yet.
article.turn: When the thrill of discovery becomes a way to dodge depth, honesty flips blunt and freedom becomes a get-out clause. We leave before accountability arrives, and generosity turns into a disappearing act. If you refuse to stay long enough to unpack the mess, you’re just collecting souvenirs, not building connection.
moves: Invite someone to share a dream you’ve never voiced before, no plan needed.
